jobs.description:
Would you like to maintain more than just another technical system and work with a technology that is truly unique worldwide? ⚡

Our client is a fast growing GreenTech startup developing one of the world’s first scalable road based power plants. The technology uses existing road infrastructure to generate renewable energy from passing traffic without requiring any additional land.

As a Maintenance Technician in Hamburg, you will be responsible for the technical operation and maintenance of the road based power plant installed there. You will ensure reliable operation, carry out maintenance and repairs, and systematically investigate technical faults.

You will not simply follow existing procedures. Since this is an entirely new technology, you will actively help shape how maintenance, service, and technical support processes are developed for the future. Your hands on experience from daily operations will directly contribute to the continued development of the service structure.

Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will be the first engineer on our Simulation team. Every site we map becomes a digital twin, built from our own lidar maps, and in it our robots see thousands of the intrusions, fires and sensor failures a real site sees once a year.
